result.summary: Found 2 major layout issues: restaurant cards are being visually truncated at the edges, preventing full content visibility.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol' restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is horizontally cut off on the right side, showing incomplete information and a truncated restaurant name
issues.suggestion: Ensure carousel cards have proper padding and overflow handling, or adjust card sizing so all content is fully visible within the viewport width

issues.description: The last restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section (pizza with -20% discount) is vertically truncated at the bottom of the page, cutting off the restaurant name and details
issues.suggestion: Add proper spacing/padding at the bottom of the page or adjust the list view to ensure all items are fully visible or have a clear 'load more' mechanism
